reason: French former Miss France 2002 who ran the Societe Miss France as its director for about 15 to 17 years (sources differ), now a media personality and author. Enough sourced press coverage across 2022 to 2026 to write a factual page.

gapNote: Current top results mix a Wikipedia entry with gossip and photo sites and disagree on the birth year (1978 or 1979) and on the length of her Miss France role (2007 to 2022, or 17 years). The page can state the discrepancy, cite the 2022 departure, the 2023 Ordre national du Merite award (26 June 2023, Matignon, presented by Marlene Schiappa, for her work with Les Bonnes Fees), her 2025 RTL remarks and her 2026 comments on the Patrick Bruel affair. No fetched source states her nationality, so nationality is left null. The July 2026 cancer remarks were only visible in photo captions and are not used.
